### Contributing guidelines

- [X] I have read [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)

### Module(s)

mini.pick

### Question

The default builtin files picker waits for the underlying command to finish execution before presenting results.
This tends to be slow in large code bases.
I am used to `fzf.vim` where the files picker presents items as they come while the command (`rg --files`) is still executing.
I searched the docs but I couldn't figure out how to achieve the same functionality with `mini.pick`.
Is it doable? and how to do it?

comment_data.body:
No, I am afraid this is not possible. Mostly by design: both to lower code complexity and because I never really understood the use case (besides maybe better visuals). Filtering and sorting may become outdated as new items come, which feels like not a great usability to me.

What *is* possible is to type the query even before results appear. So users don't *have to* wait until results are shown to start filtering them.
